A1.justification: Both PDFs describe DEEPER and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices. Retained content can be matched across appendix reorganization and table renumbering.

before.justification: V1 reports original rating-prediction experiments across ten domains, ablations, persona analyses and a user case study.

after.justification: V2 retains those empirical results and adds supervised-baseline comparisons, pairwise-choice evaluation and Qwen2-7B transfer results.

M1.justification: The discrepancy-based refinement procedure, three-component reward, two training iterations and combined DPO/SFT objective remain unchanged. The added 'offline RL' terminology clarifies the existing procedure; Qwen2 is an additional backbone evaluation.

E1.justification: V2 adds a pairwise-choice prediction task involving 600 users in Appendix F.2. The original four datasets and ten domains remain covered. Movies and TV was already evaluated in v1; its added Table 11 row fills a documentation gap.

E2.justification: Table 24 adds task-specific SFT versions of HierMerge, IncUpdate, SlideRegen and FullRegen using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. These extend existing comparator families. GPT-4o-mini baselines and the separately preference-trained Inc-FT comparison were already present in v1.

E3.justification: New experiments introduce self-sampling and rejection sampling for baseline SFT, a 600-user choice-accuracy evaluation after one refinement step, and Qwen2-7B-Instruct fine-tuning. The original rating benchmark protocol and DEEPER training settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix F adds checks of whether supervised baseline training closes the optimization gap and whether DEEPER transfers across tasks and backbones. Existing reward, iteration and prediction-discrepancy ablations, persona probing and the book-user case study are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals or significance tests. The added evaluations continue reporting point estimates.

E6.justification: V2 adds SFT-baseline results, pairwise accuracy of 61% before versus 68% after refinement, and Qwen MAE reductions of 13.1% in seen and 10.8% in unseen domains. Existing entries also change in Tables 14, 16, 17, 19 and 21. In Table 21, Sports and Outdoors DEEPER changes from 0.91 to 0.80 while Inc-FT remains 0.81, reversing that row's ranking. The main DEEPER trajectories in Table 13 remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The task and direction definitions, reward equations and loss formulations are retained. The item-index notation correction does not change mathematical substance, and no new formal proofs or assumptions are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the claims of continual persona optimization through discrepancy-based direction search. The headline 32.2% error reduction and claimed advantage over the best baseline are unchanged.

C2.justification: Appendix F.2 newly argues that the training dataset is reusable across tasks and models and reduces repeated training and reward-computation costs. This extends the practicality and scalability interpretation. The existing Limitations section remains unchanged.

D1.justification: V2 identifies LlamaFactory as the training implementation and supplies the previously omitted Movies and TV counts of 1,000 training and 837 evaluation users. Appendix F adds limited information about baseline supervision and transfer settings. Existing prompts, hyperparameter tables and resource link are retained.

R1.justification: V2 adds citations to the Qwen2 technical report and LlamaFactory. Section 6 and the central positioning against regeneration and extension methods remain unchanged. The additional GPT-4 reference duplicates an already cited work.

P1.justification: Dataset details move from Appendix B into A.4–A.5, subsequent appendices are relabeled, and Additional Analysis is inserted as Appendix F. Local terminology and typo corrections, affiliation updates and an acknowledgement are added; the main narrative is largely retained.

P2.justification: V2 adds Tables 24–26 and renumbers the retained case-study tables. Table 11 gains the omitted domain row and a corrected column heading. Figure 2's training labels and some captions change, while the existing plots and overall visual design are retained.

improvement.justification: V2 improves completeness through the restored dataset information, clearer offline-training terminology and corrections such as Table 21's inconsistent DEEPER entry. The SFT comparisons and task/backbone transfer results provide useful additional support. These gains are limited by sparse documentation of the new protocols and broad scalability claims without measured computational costs or uncertainty estimates; the core method and principal evidence remain stable.
